source_boundary.before:
实验中说振动“停止”，也可能只是振幅已小到难以分辨。
不同摩擦机制下的最终停止过程可能不同，不能仅凭示意图规定统一的精确停止时刻。
source_boundary.after:
物体仍作往复运动时，位移随时间变化的阻尼曲线可示意为图 $16$。
图中的振幅逐渐减小，但曲线是示意图，不是供读取精确周期、衰减率或停止时刻的测量记录。
图 $8$ 介绍带砂子的摆所用的记录方法和装置。

boundary_suggestions.concept_transition: Mechanical-energy dissipation, oscillatory versus nonoscillatory damping and qualified stopping descriptions to the schematic displacement-time curve and sand-pendulum recording method
boundary_suggestions.before_suggestion:
In an experiment, saying that oscillations have "stopped" may simply mean that their amplitude has become too small to distinguish.
Different friction mechanisms may lead to different final stopping processes. A schematic diagram alone cannot establish a single exact stopping time for all of them.
boundary_suggestions.after_suggestion: While the object still moves back and forth, its damped displacement-versus-time curve can be represented schematically as in Figure $16$.

source_boundary.before:
按照原书的说明，在悬线上装上硬纸片增大空气阻力，可以用这种方法记录前述衰减类型的图线。
装置图中原有的轨迹并不因此成为精确的阻尼曲线。
source_boundary.after:
原书列举安培表和瓦特表这类带指针的电工测量仪表。
对这类仪表，接通后，指针可能在与被测值对应的平衡位置附近振动，经过一段时间才稳定到便于读数的程度。
为了缩短等待时间，可以用专门的装置给指针增加适当的阻尼。

boundary_suggestions.concept_transition: The recording apparatus and its nonmeasurement trace to suitable damping for instrument-pointer settling, response tradeoffs and electromagnetic dissipation
boundary_suggestions.before_suggestion:
According to the original book, attaching a piece of stiff paper to the suspension string to increase air resistance allows this method to record the type of decaying curve described above.
The trace already shown in the apparatus drawing does not thereby become an exact damped-oscillation curve.
boundary_suggestions.after_suggestion: The original book gives ammeters and wattmeters as examples of electrical measuring instruments with pointers.

source_boundary.before:
电流与磁场的相互作用形成阻碍运动的作用，从而使振动较快减弱。
这个过程使指针运动的机械能被耗散为内能，而不是把机械能凭空消除。
金属片静止地放在磁场中，本身并不意味着会持续产生这种用于阻尼的感应电流。
source_boundary.after:
汽车在不平路面行驶时，路面的持续作用可以激起车身振动。
减振器的作用是减弱这种振动，不能把车辆行驶时的所有振动都当作只受阻力的自由振动，也不能保证车身完全不动。
原书描述的液压减振器有与车身相联的活塞，活塞在充满液体的缸内移动。

boundary_suggestions.concept_transition: Motion-induced currents, opposing electromagnetic action and internal-energy dissipation to hydraulic vehicle damping under continuing road excitation
boundary_suggestions.before_suggestion:
interaction between these currents and the magnetic field opposes the motion, making the oscillations die down more quickly.
In this process, the mechanical energy of the pointer's motion is dissipated as internal energy, not simply eliminated.
Merely placing a stationary metal plate in a magnetic field does not by itself mean that these damping currents will be continuously induced.
boundary_suggestions.after_suggestion: As a car travels over an uneven road, the road's continuing action can excite oscillations of the car body.

translation_preservation_notes.preserved_scope: Ideal spring and small-angle pendulum models, free oscillations, neglected resistance and the restoring-model requirement are retained. No friction is not promoted into a sufficient condition for arbitrary free motion to be simple harmonic.

The absence of continuing external driving applies to this system only. Negative work converts mechanical energy into internal energy without disappearance of total energy. Weak oscillatory damping and nonoscillatory approach under greater resistance remain distinct. Finite exact stopping, asymptotic approach in the linear viscous idealization, measurement limits and different friction mechanisms remain qualified.

Figures $16$ and $8$ retain their token order. The damped curve is schematic, not an exact period, decay-rate or stopping-time record. The sand-pendulum method with paper on the suspension string remains attributed to the original book; the pre-existing apparatus trace is not treated as a measured damping curve.

Ammeter/wattmeter pointers settle near the measured-value equilibrium. Suitable damping shortens waiting, but excessive damping can slow nonoscillatory approach. The moving metal plate, the specified field arrangement, induced currents, opposing interaction and mechanical-to-internal-energy conversion are retained. A stationary plate alone does not imply continuous damping currents.

The moving car remains continuously excited by the uneven road. Hydraulic piston motion, oil flow through passages, resistance and mechanical-energy dissipation reduce oscillations but do not guarantee a motionless body or a precise finite stop. No free-vibration-only assumption is applied to the moving vehicle.
